meta.name: pyvene-interventions
meta.description: Provides guidance for performing causal interventions on PyTorch models using pyvene's declarative intervention framework. Use when conducting causal tracing, activation patching, interchange intervention training, or testing causal hypotheses about model behavior.

copy.tagline: 对神经网络模型进行因果干预实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用PyTorch研究模型内部机制或验证因果假设
copy.tagline_en: Run causal intervention experiments on neural models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study model internals or test causal hypotheses in PyTorch

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 pyvene 库对 PyTorch 模型进行因果干预，例如激活替换、因果追踪和可训练干预，并生成可复现的实验代码。
howto.when: 当你需要定位模型内部因果关系、测试组件重要性或训练干预时触发，例如进行因果追踪、激活修补或交换干预训练。

say.text: 用激活修补分析 GPT-2 在 IOI 任务中哪些注意力层重要。
say.note: Claude 会输出每层修补后的 logit 差异。

say.text: 教我如何用 pyvene 训练一个可旋转的干预来发现因果方向。
say.note: Claude 会给出 DAS 训练步骤和代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in using the pyvene library to perform causal interventions on PyTorch models, such as activation patching, causal tracing, and trainable interventions, producing reproducible experiment code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to localize causal mechanisms, test component importance, or train interventions, e.g., for causal tracing, activation patching, or interchange intervention training.

say_en.text: Help me do causal tracing on GPT-2 with pyvene to locate the fact 'Space Needle in Seattle'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate causal tracing code and explain results.

say_en.text: Use activation patching to analyze which attention layers matter in GPT-2 for the IOI task.
say_en.note: Claude will output logit differences per layer.

say_en.text: Show me how to train a rotatable intervention with pyvene to discover causal directions.
say_en.note: Claude will provide DAS training steps and code.
